newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stock market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stock market closed for holiday.

text.p: Sri Lanka's stock market was closed on Tuesday for Independence Day, a national holiday.
The market will reopen on Wednesday.
On Monday, the market closed a fraction higher for the first time in four days, with the Colombo Stock Exchange all share price index ending 0.31 points up at 621.93. Turnover was 9.7 million rupees.
The index has been easing since hitting 633.5 points on January 27.
